## 📋 Today's Overview
*July 29, 2026*

### Majorana (2 new today)

1. **DC Conductance of X-shaped Majorana Interferometer reveals Non-Abelian Anyon Statistics**: The study focuses on an X-shaped chiral Majorana interferometer with a central floating superconducting island, employing linear-response DC conductance tensor measurements to directly detect the non-Abelian statistics of Ising anyons realized as edge vortices.
2. **Current cross-correlations as probes for poor man's Majorana states**: The study focuses on a minimal Kitaev chain of three quantum dots emulating a topological superconductor, employing current-current correlation measurements to verify the true non-locality of poor man's Majorana modes beyond standard conductance spectroscopy.

| 1 | **[DC Conductance of X-shaped Majorana Interferometer reveals Non-Abelian Anyon Statistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24171v1)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>We propose a four-terminal, X-shaped chiral Majorana interferometer with a central floating superconducting island, enabling the direct detection of the non-Abelian statistics of Ising anyons via the linear-response DC conductance tensor in charge transport experiments. Here, Ising anyons are realizable as edge vortices nucleated at Josephson line junctions defining the superconducting island, where both edge-vortex and Majorana-fermion tunneling processes can occur. We show that in such a multi-terminal Majorana interferometer, both the vacuum and the fermionic fusion channel for Ising anyons are possible. This is in contrast to two-arm interferometers, where only the vacuum fusion channel is accessible and the DC conductance contribution from edge vortices always vanishes. Using a low-energy effective theory derived via chiral bosonization, we find that in the X-shaped interferometer, the DC conductance tensor is completely isotropic, yielding a non-zero conductance when simultaneous edge-vortex and Majorana tunneling activates the fermionic fusion channel. Apart from conductance oscillations in a gate-tunable charge parameter, which display an offset related to the anyon topological spin, measuring a finite conductance can already provide direct evidence for non-Abelian statistics in this geometry.</p></details><details><summary>中文</summary><p>我们提出一种四端X形手征马约拉纳干涉仪，其中心设有浮空超导岛，通过电荷输运实验中的线性响应直流电导张量，可直接探测伊辛任意子的非阿贝尔统计性质。此处，伊辛任意子可实现在定义超导岛的约瑟夫森结线结处成核的边缘涡旋，其中边缘涡旋与马约拉纳费米子隧穿过程均可发生。研究表明，在此类多端马约拉纳干涉仪中，伊辛任意子的真空融合通道与费米子融合通道均可实现。这与双臂干涉仪形成对比——后者仅能实现真空融合通道，且边缘涡旋对直流电导的贡献始终为零。通过手征玻色化导出的低能有效理论，我们发现X形干涉仪的直流电导张量完全各向同性：当边缘涡旋与马约拉纳隧穿同时激活费米子融合通道时，可产生非零电导。除栅极可调电荷参数引起的电导振荡（其偏移量与任意子拓扑自旋相关）外，测量有限电导本身即可为此几何结构中非阿贝尔统计性质提供直接证据。</p></details> | 2026-07-27 | Domenico Giuliano et al. |
| 2 | **[Current cross-correlations as probes for poor man's Majorana states](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23498v1)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>The minimal Kitaev chain that emulates a topological superconductor with three quantum dots offers a tunable platform for potentially hosting poor man's Majorana (PMM) modes. Asserting the need to go beyond differential conductance spectroscopy, we introduce current-current correlations as a viable framework for verifying their true non-locality. The robustness of the PMM modes, specifically with respect to delocalization as the system is tuned away from sweet spots, we show, is embedded in the relative magnitudes of the nonlocal transport processes. This aspect is adeptly captured by current cross-correlations, whose features show remarkable stability around the PMM sweet spot, specifically with respect to the detuning of an outer dot. We establish this as a prominent feature and a diagnostic for true PMMs even in the short chain limit. Our results accentuate the need for current cross-correlation measurements as a diagnostic framework for unambiguously verifying true non-locality of entangled states as well as topologically protected states.</p></details><details><summary>中文</summary><p>由三个量子点模拟拓扑超导体的最小基塔耶夫链，为可能承载穷人马约拉纳模式提供了可调控平台。鉴于需超越微分电导谱学，我们引入电流-电流关联作为验证其真正非局域性的可行框架。研究表明，穷人马约拉纳模式对退局域化的鲁棒性（尤其是系统偏离甜点时的表现）内嵌于非局域输运过程的相对强度中。电流互关联函数可精准捕捉该特性，其特征在穷人马约拉纳甜点附近（特别是外量子点失谐时）展现出显著稳定性。我们将其确立为短链极限下识别真正穷人马约拉纳模式的显著特征与诊断工具。我们的结果强调，电流互关联测量作为诊断框架，对明确验证纠缠态及拓扑保护态的真正非局域性具有必要性。</p></details> | 2026-07-26 | Saatwik Patnaik et al. |
| 3 | **[Majorana bound states in anisotropic and tilted Dirac and Weyl systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.19707v1)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>Topological superconductors host Majorana boundary modes whose robustness is protected by the nontrivial topology of the bulk Bogoliubov quasiparticle spectrum. While Majorana bound states associated with Dirac and Weyl quasiparticles have been extensively investigated, much less is known about how anisotropic quasiparticle velocities and tilted band structures modify their microscopic properties. Here, we develop an analytical framework for Majorana bound states in effective two-dimensional (2D) Bogoliubov--de Gennes Dirac theories describing the surface quasiparticles of topological superconductors and extend the analysis to three-dimensional (3D) tilted Weyl systems by establishing a microscopic connection to the same low-energy description through superconducting pairing. For anisotropic 2D Dirac systems, we derive closed analytical expressions for the continuum topological invariant, Majorana wave function, localization length, propagation velocity, and finite-size minigap for arbitrary interface orientations. We show that the chirality of the Majorana channel is determined by the sign of the velocity-matrix determinant, while its localization and dispersion are governed jointly by the velocity tensor and the interface geometry. For tilted 2D Dirac cones, we demonstrate that the tilt leaves the spinor eigenstates, Berry phase, and projected pairing symmetry unchanged, but strongly suppresses the Majorana propagation velocity and finite-size minigap as the Lifshitz transition between type-I and type-II regimes is approached. Finally, we consider superconducting tilted 3D Weyl systems and show that the projection of a conventional spin-singlet $s$-wave pairing interaction onto the low-energy Weyl bands naturally generates an effective chiral $p_x\pm ip_y$ pairing symmetry, providing a microscopic Bogoliubov--de Gennes description that supports localized Majorana surface states.</p></details><details><summary>中文</summary><p>拓扑超导体承载马约拉纳边界模，其鲁棒性由体态博戈留波夫准粒子谱的非平凡拓扑保护。尽管与狄拉克和韦尔准粒子相关的马约拉纳束缚态已被广泛研究，但各向异性准粒子速度和倾斜能带结构如何改变其微观性质仍知之甚少。本文针对描述拓扑超导体表面准粒子的有效二维博戈留波夫-德热纳狄拉克理论，建立了马约拉纳束缚态的分析框架，并通过超导配对建立与同一低能描述的微观联系，将分析扩展至三维倾斜韦尔系统。对于各向异性二维狄拉克系统，我们推导出连续拓扑不变量、马约拉纳波函数、局域化长度、传播速度及任意界面取向有限尺寸微隙的闭合解析表达式。研究表明，马约拉纳通道的手性由速度矩阵行列式的符号决定，而其局域化与色散关系则由速度张量与界面几何共同调控。对于倾斜二维狄拉克锥，我们证明倾斜不改变旋量本征态、贝里相位及投影配对对称性，但随着I型与II型体系间利夫希茨转变的临近，会强烈抑制马约拉纳传播速度与有限尺寸微隙。最后，我们考虑超导倾斜三维韦尔系统，表明传统自旋单态s波配对相互作用在低能韦尔能带上的投影自然产生有效手性p_x±ip_y配对对称性，从而提供支持局域马约拉纳表面态的微观博戈留波夫-德热纳描述。</p></details> | 2026-07-22 | Abraham Kaleb Plascencia Pérez Páez et al. |
| 4 | **[Simulating Majorana fermions in black hole with Ising Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.18805v1)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>Quantum field theory (QFT) in curved spacetime has led to profound predictions, including the Unruh effect and Hawking radiation, yet their direct observation remains extraordinarily challenging because of their extremely weak signatures. Here, we show that the transverse-field Ising model provides a quantum simulator for Majorana fermions in a Schwarzschild black hole background. Remarkably, different coordinate representations of the same spacetime-Schwarzschild, tortoise, Kruskal, and conformally flat-map onto distinct microscopic Ising spin models. Despite their microscopic differences, these models converge in the continuum limit to the same Majorana field theory, exhibiting an emergent form of general covariance. This provides a rare example of a fundamental symmetry of general relativity arising as an emergent property of a condensed matter system. We further demonstrate how black hole particle production can be simulated and detected through spin correlation measurements, and discuss experimental platforms capable of realizing these models. Our work establishes a practical route for investigating fermionic QFT in curved spacetime using controllable quantum many-body systems and tabletop experiments.</p></details><details><summary>中文</summary><p>弯曲时空中的量子场论已催生深刻预言，包括安鲁效应与霍金辐射，然而因其信号极其微弱，直接观测仍面临巨大挑战。本文证明，横场伊辛模型可作为施瓦西黑洞背景中马约拉纳费米子的量子模拟器。值得注意的是，同一时空——施瓦西坐标、龟坐标、克鲁斯卡尔坐标及共形平直坐标——的不同坐标表示，分别映射为截然不同的微观伊辛自旋模型。尽管这些模型在微观层面存在差异，但在连续极限下均收敛至同一马约拉纳场论，展现出一种涌现形式的广义协变性。这为广义相对论的基本对称性作为凝聚态系统涌现性质提供了罕见范例。我们进一步展示了如何通过自旋关联测量模拟并探测黑洞粒子产生过程，并讨论了可实现这些模型的实验平台。本研究利用可控量子多体系统与桌面实验，为研究弯曲时空中费米子量子场论开辟了可行路径。</p></details> | 2026-07-21 | John Vienn A. Estremadura et al. |
| 5 | **[Phase-controlled quasi-bound states in the continuum and thermoelectric enhancement in Majorana-quantum-dot nanostructures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.15990v1)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>We investigate how the interplay between Majorana zero modes (MZMs) and bound states in the continuum (BICs) governs the electronic thermoelectric response of a crossbar-shaped quantum dot (QD) coupled to two topological-superconductor nanowires. Using the Green-function formalism, exact linear-response energy integrals, and their low-temperature Sommerfeld expansion, we analyze the spectral and thermoelectric properties of the system. We show that symmetry breaking converts BICs into quasi-BICs, allowing them to contribute to electrical and thermal transport and thereby generate a finite thermoelectric response. While unequal nanowire lengths, reflected in different intra-Majorana coupling strengths, produce only a modest enhancement of $ZT_{el}$, detuning the QD level increases $ZT_{el}$ by approximately one order of magnitude. Superconducting-phase control produces a much stronger enhancement, reaching $ZT_{el} \simeq 0.75$ through a quadratic transmission zero and a pronounced violation of the Wiedemann-Franz law. The low-temperature values $ZT^{max}_{el} \simeq 0.755$ and $\mathscr{L} /\mathscr{L}_{0} = 21/5$ are universal consequences of this quadratic antiresonance. Our results establish phase-tunable thermoelectric signatures of the Majorana-coupled interference structure and identify superconducting-phase control as an efficient means of engineering the electronic response of topological hybrid nanostructures.</p></details><details><summary>中文</summary><p>我们研究了马约拉纳零模与连续谱中的束缚态之间的相互作用如何调控与两条拓扑超导纳米线耦合的十字形量子点的电子热电响应。利用格林函数形式、精确线性响应能量积分及其低温索末菲展开，我们分析了该系统的谱学与热电性质。研究表明，对称性破缺将连续谱中的束缚态转化为准束缚态，使其能够参与电输运和热输运，从而产生有限的热电响应。尽管纳米线长度不等（体现为不同的马约拉纳内耦合强度）仅能使$ZT_{el}$适度增强，但量子点能级的失谐可将$ZT_{el}$提升约一个数量级。超导相位调控可产生更强的增强效应，通过二次传输零点及对维德曼-弗朗兹定律的显著偏离，使$ZT_{el}$达到约0.75。低温下的$ZT^{max}_{el} \simeq 0.755$及$\mathscr{L} /\mathscr{L}_{0} = 21/5$是这种二次反共振的普适结果。我们的研究确立了马约拉纳耦合干涉结构的相位可调热电特征，并识别出超导相位控制是调控拓扑杂化纳米结构电子响应的有效手段。</p></details> | 2026-07-17 | Alejandro Garrido et al. |
| 6 | **[Avoiding Dilution: Using Diffusion and Vision Transformers to resolve Majorana Features in Nanowires at High Temperature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.14949v1)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>Identifying Majorana zero modes in semiconductor--superconductor nanowires requires ultra-low temperature transport measurements in dilution refrigerators, making device screening slow and resource-intensive. Here, we investigate whether high-temperature conductance data can be used to infer low-temperature Majorana nanowire properties before committing devices to dilution-refrigerator characterization. We generate paired high- and low-temperature conductance simulations for disordered Majorana nanowires and train neural networks to perform two related tasks. First, we use a Shifted Window U-Net Transformer diffusion-inspired architecture to reconstruct low-temperature conductance from thermally broadened high-temperature measurements, achieving high-fidelity recovery with $R^2 \approx {0.95}$ for local conductance and $R^2 \approx {0.91}$ for nonlocal conductance. Second, we train a Video Vision Transformer-based network to predict the low-temperature topological visibility directly from high-temperature conductance, obtaining $R^2 \approx {0.80}$. These results demonstrate that machine-learning models can recover and infer low-temperature Majorana features from experimentally easier high-temperature data, providing a practical route for rejecting poor devices early thus avoiding slow and resource-intensive dilution refrigeration for non-promising devices. This high-temperature screening approach could substantially accelerate the experimental feedback loop for Majorana nanowire device development.</p></details><details><summary>中文</summary><p>。我们发现，在拓扑侧，开链中出现马约拉纳边缘模，表现为奇偶宇称基态间的能量劈裂随系统尺寸增大而消失。此外，非对角的两点关联函数显示出非局域的、依赖于宇称的边缘效应。这些关联揭示了多体波函数中马约拉纳模的空间结构。我们证明该关联诊断方法具有广泛适用性，包括短程相互作用模型——由于缺乏体激发能隙，此类模型中的拓扑超导电性更为脆弱。</p></details> | 2026-07-16 | Jacob R. Taylor et al. |
| 7 | **[Majorana edge modes in isolated wires](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.00158v2)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>Topological superconductors are believed to host exotic quasiparticle excitations known as Majorana zero-modes (MZMs), with much of the evidence based on BCS mean-field theory. The direct application of mean-field arguments is tenuous in finite, isolated systems relevant in some experiments. Here, we develop a new correlation-based method for identifying MZMs in interacting, number-conserving systems. Using DMRG, we study fermion number-conserving models with long-range interactions, which under periodic boundary conditions exhibit robust topological and non-topological superconductivity, tuned by the strength of interaction [1]. We find evidence that, on the topological side, Majorana edge modes appear in open chains, manifesting as the vanishing of the energy splitting between odd- and even-parity ground states with increasing system size. Additionally, off-diagonal two-point correlation functions show nonlocal, parity-dependent edge effects. These correlations reveal the spatial structure of Majorana modes in the many-body wavefunction. We show that the correlation diagnostic applies broadly, including to short-range interacting models, where topological superconductivity is more fragile due to the absence of a bulk excitation gap.</p></details><details><summary>中文</summary><p>拓扑超导体被认为承载称为马约拉纳零模（MZMs）的奇异准粒子激发，相关证据多基于BCS平均场理论。在部分实验所涉及的有穷孤立系统中，直接应用平均场论证是薄弱的。本文针对相互作用的粒子数守恒系统，开发了一种基于关联函数的新方法用于识别MZMs。利用DMRG方法，我们研究了具有长程相互作用的费米子数守恒模型，在周期性边界条件下，该模型通过调节相互作用强度可呈现稳健的拓扑与非拓扑超导电性</p></details> | 2026-07-15 | Jaden Thomas-Markarian et al. |
| 8 | **[Formation and Evolution of the Spin-Charge-Entangled Screening Cloud in the Majorana-Kondo System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.16446v2)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>Side-coupled Majorana zero modes in Kondo systems realize a simple yet nontrivial hybridization setup that leads to distinct physics from the conventional Kondo effect. We have demonstrated in a previous work that the system can be described by a spin-charge-entangled (SCE) quantum impurity model with an Andreev$\otimes$normal boundary condition. Here we investigate in detail the formation process and microscopic mechanism of the SCE screening cloud using the numerical renormalization group method. We introduce temperature-dependent spatially integrated correlation functions that provide an unambiguous diagnostic of different components of the SCE screening cloud beyond the impurity entropy and local density of states. Our results reveal a crossover from a sequential two-stage screening of the spin and charge components to a simultaneous screening controlled by a single parameter. We also study the evolution of the low-energy fixed points in the presence of competing terms that break different symmetries and drive the system to different infrared fixed points. Our results suggest that the SCE screening effect in the Majorana-Kondo system makes itself a route to detecting Majorana zero modes.</p></details><details><summary>中文</summary><p>近藤体系中的侧耦合马约拉纳零模实现了一种简单但非平庸的杂化结构，从而产生与常规近藤效应截然不同的物理现象。我们先前的工作已证明，该体系可用具有安德烈夫⊗正常边界条件的自旋-电荷纠缠（SCE）量子杂质模型来描述。本文利用数值重整化群方法，详细研究了SCE屏蔽云的形成过程与微观机制。我们引入了与温度相关的空间积分关联函数，该函数能够超越杂质熵和局域态密度，为SCE屏蔽云的不同组分提供明确的诊断依据。研究结果揭示了从自旋与电荷分量的顺序两阶段屏蔽到由单一参数控制的同步屏蔽的交叉行为。我们还研究了在存在破坏不同对称性并驱动体系趋向不同红外不动点的竞争项时，低能不动点的演化过程。结果表明，马约拉纳-近藤体系中的SCE屏蔽效应为探测马约拉纳零模提供了一条可行路径。</p></details> | 2026-07-15 | Yun Chen et al. |

| 1 | **[Non-Abelian Quantum Signal Processing: A Composite Pulse for Fast Analytic Control of Hybrid Oscillator-Qubit Processors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.19992v5)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>Quantum Signal Processing (QSP) transforms a unitary parameterized by a classical variable $θ$ into one governed by a polynomial function $f(θ)$. Though quantum mechanics is linear, such highly nonlinear transformations arise naturally from the curvature of the qubit Bloch sphere. The QSP primitive underpins most quantum algorithms and finds broad utility in robust control by decreasing sensitivity to parameter errors, and in quantum sensing by increasing sensitivity to target parameters. In this work, we extend QSP to a new multivariate class, non-Abelian QSP, that utilizes a set of non-commuting (operator-valued) control parameters $\{\hatθ_1, \hatθ_2, \dots\}$. Experimental instantiations of this richer algebraic structure are currently being explored in hybrid oscillator-qubit systems realized in superconducting and trapped-ion processors, where the non-commuting variables are oscillator positions and momenta. We demonstrate the utility of our construction, the Gaussian-controlled-rotation (GCR) which is a canonical instance of this class, across three domains: fully analytical state preparation circuits whose performance matches state-of-the-art machine-learning protocols for preparing squeezed, cat, GKP, and Fock states; a complete analytical framework for universal control of GKP bosonic error-corrected qubits, including logical readout and error-corrected gate teleportation --with mid-circuit error detection and generalization to arbitrary lattices, qudits, and multi-mode codes uniquely enabled by the analytical structure; and a construction closing a key gap in oscillator-aided quantum phase estimation algorithms. These results establish non-Abelian QSP as a powerful new frontier, one that is not merely of theoretical interest but ready to be put to work in the laboratory today.</p></details><details><summary>中文</summary><p>量子信号处理（QSP）将依赖于经典变量θ的酉变换转化为由多项式函数f(θ)控制的酉变换。尽管量子力学是线性的，但这种高度非线性的变换却自然产生于量子比特布洛赫球的曲率。QSP基本操作支撑着大多数量子算法，并在鲁棒控制（通过降低对参数误差的敏感性）和量子传感（通过增强对目标参数的敏感性）中具有广泛用途。本文将QSP扩展到一个新的多元类别——非阿贝尔QSP，该类别利用一组非对易的（算符值）控制参数{θ̂₁, θ̂₂, …}。目前，在超导和离子阱处理器中实现的混合振子-量子比特系统中，正在探索这种更丰富代数结构的实验实例，其中非对易变量是振子的位置和动量。我们展示了该构造——高斯控制旋转（GCR），作为该类别的典型实例——在三个领域的效用：完全解析的状态制备线路，其性能与制备压缩态、猫态、GKP态和福克态的最先进机器学习协议相当；一个用于GKP玻色子纠错量子比特通用控制的完整解析框架，包括逻辑读出和纠错门隐形传态——其中独特的解析结构实现了线路中间的错误检测以及对任意晶格、量子比特和多模编码的推广；以及一项填补了振子辅助量子相位估计算法关键空白的构造。这些结果确立了非阿贝尔QSP作为一个强大的新前沿，它不仅具有理论意义，而且已准备好投入当前的实验室应用。</p></details> | 2026-07-27 | Shraddha Singh et al. |
| 2 | **[Thermal Quantum Correlations in Coupled Andreev Spin Qubits: Interplay of Superconducting Phase and Spin-Orbit Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24521v1)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>We investigate thermal quantum correlations in a system of two coupled superconducting spin qubits described by an effective Andreev spin-qubit Hamiltonian in the presence of spin-orbit interaction. Using Local Quantum Fisher Information (LQFI) and Local Quantum Uncertainty (LQU) as quantum-correlation quantifiers, we analyze the effects of the superconducting phase difference, tunneling amplitude, spin-orbit coupling, and temperature on the nonclassical properties of the system. | 3 | **[Evolution of tripartite entanglement in three-qubit Quantum Gravity-Induced Entanglement of Masses (QGEM) with quantum decoherence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.01007v3)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>The recently introduced quantum gravity-induced entanglement of masses (QGEM) protocol aims to test the quantum nature of gravity by witnessing the entanglement produced by the virtual exchange of a graviton between two spatially superposed masses. | 4 | **[Pound-Drever-Hall Feedforward for Trapped-Ion Optical Qubits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24050v1)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>Laser phase noise is one of the limiting factors that dictate gate fidelities and coherence times in trapped-ion quantum systems. | 5 | **[Scaling a CUDA-Q GQE + QSCI pipeline to 40 qubits for EUV photoresist chemistry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23988v1)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>We scale a CUDA-Q-native pipeline coupling a generative quantum eigensolver (GQE) to quantum-selected configuration interaction (QSCI) across active spaces of 14 to 44 qubits, applied to the extreme-ultraviolet (EUV) photoresist chemistry of monoalkyltin oxo-hydroxides. | 6 | **[Scalable Photon-Mediated Two-Qubit Gates with Spectrally Noisy Quantum Emitters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23959v1)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>When two quantum bits are coupled through a cavity, a two-qubit gate can be realized between them either in the near-resonant regime over a timescale established by the coupling strength of the qubits with the cavity, or in the dispersive regime, over a longer timescale established by the combination of the coupling strength and the frequency detuning between the qubits and the cavity. Namely, for a cavity with low damping rate, we apply a sequence of pulses to the qubits at the frequency of the cavity while periodically modulating the coupling of the qubits to the cavity. Alternatively, in the case of a large damping rate, we operate in the dispersive regime and overcome spectral disparities by applying the pulses at a frequency far-detuned from the cavity. In both instances, we find for the quantum state transfer between the two qubits that, with a modest inter-pulse delay, the fidelity that would otherwise be strongly suppressed by the spectral mismatch of the qubits can be increased beyond 99.9%. These protocols have the capacity to bring two-qubit gates between solid state systems across the threshold required for fault-tolerant quantum computing.</p></details><details><summary>中文</summary><p>当两个量子比特通过腔耦合时，可以在近共振区域（时间尺度由量子比特与腔的耦合强度决定）或色散区域（时间尺度由耦合强度与量子比特-腔频率失谐共同决定）实现两量子比特门。当量子比特存在频谱噪声或与腔的失谐量不同时，两种情况下门操作的保真度都可能大幅降低，从而阻碍可扩展实现。我们提出了最优腔辅助门协议（POCEG），通过可靠的数值与解析解证明，该协议能够克服量子比特间的频谱差异，并在不同/含噪量子发射体之间实现高保真度。具体而言，对于低阻尼率的腔，我们在腔频率处对量子比特施加脉冲序列，同时周期性调制量子比特与腔的耦合。对于高阻尼率的情况，我们工作在色散区域，通过施加频率远失谐于腔的脉冲来克服频谱差异。在两种情形下，我们发现对于两量子比特间的量子态转移，采用适中的脉冲间延迟，原本会因量子比特频谱失配而被严重抑制的保真度可提升至99.9%以上。这些协议有能力将固态系统间的两量子比特门推进至容错量子计算所需的阈值以上。</p></details> | 2026-07-27 | Shreekanth S. Yuvarajan et al. |
| 7 | **[Neural Network Learning of One-Bit Protocols for Qubit Measurement Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23645v1)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>Communication complexity provides a natural framework for quantifying the classical resources required to reproduce quantum statistics. By analyzing the patterns learned by the neural network, we derive an analytical protocol that is extremely accurate for finite information- ally complete symmetric configurations and becomes exact in the limit of a continuous isotropic measurement.</p></details><details><summary>中文</summary><p>通信复杂度为量化复现量子统计所需的经典资源提供了自然框架。在量子比特制备-测量场景中，已证明两个经典比特对于精确模拟任意量子比特态和任意量子测量是必要且充分的。然而，这一结果并不排除受限测量族可能允许精确的1比特经典近似。我们使用神经网络程序证明，对于特定测量族，单个比特即可实现高平均精度。对神经网络的性能分析表明，具有均匀加权元素的对称测量（如构成正多面体的测量）特别适合这种受限通信。通过分析神经网络学习到的模式，我们推导出一个解析协议，该协议对于有限的信息完备对称构型极为精确，并在连续各向同性测量的极限下成为精确解。</p></details> | 2026-07-26 | Josep Escrig et al. |
| 8 | **[Optimal Dynamic Cooling of Multiple Qubits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23641v1)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>We solve the closed-system problem of cooling $M$ qubits, selected from $N$ identical thermal qubits, to the lowest common local temperature allowed by unitarity. The optimal protocol consists of two conceptually distinct steps. First, a passive rearrangement assigns the largest eigenvalues of the initial state to target sectors of lowest Hamming weight, thereby minimizing the total target energy. Second, a target-only complex-Hadamard transformation within each fixed-Hamming-weight subspace equalizes the one-qubit target marginals without changing any target-sector probability or the total energy. Consequently, imposing a common local temperature costs neither cooling depth nor additional work: the constrained optimum coincides with the unconstrained passive minimum for every $N>M$ and every initial temperature. The complex-Hadamard correction may nevertheless be costly at the circuit level. We therefore derive an exact arithmetic criterion for when the same optimum can be attained by a temperature-independent computational-basis permutation alone, and exhaustively classify the resulting finite-size islands of feasibility for $M+2\leq N\leq 128$. At isolated temperatures, further optimal permutations can arise through numerical cancellations between different thermal eigenvalue shells. These alternative realizations may reduce implementation complexity, but they cannot improve the cooling curve already attained by the universal protocol. We also derive the exact cooling curve, prove that at least two ancillary qubits are necessary and sufficient for nontrivial cooling, and show that joint many-target cooling can strictly outperform parallel single-target strategies.</p></details><details><summary>中文</summary><p>我们解决了从N个相同热量子比特中选取M个量子比特进行冷却的封闭系统问题，目标是达到幺正性允许的最低共同局域温度。最优协议包含两个概念上不同的步骤。首先，被动重排将初始态的最大本征值分配给汉明权重最低的目标扇区，从而最小化目标总能量。其次，在每个固定汉明权重的子空间内，仅作用于目标的复哈达玛变换在不改变任何目标扇区概率或总能量的情况下，使单量子比特目标边缘分布相等。因此，施加共同局域温度既不损失冷却深度，也不增加额外功：对于所有N>M和任意初始温度，约束最优值均与无约束被动最小值一致。然而，复哈达玛修正可能在电路层面代价高昂。因此，我们推导了一个精确的算术判据，用于判断何时仅通过温度无关的计算基置换即可达到相同最优值，并穷举分类了M+2≤N≤128范围内的有限尺寸可行性孤岛。在孤立温度点，不同热本征值壳层间的数值抵消可能产生进一步的最优置换。这些替代实现可能降低实现复杂度，但无法改善通用协议已获得的冷却曲线。我们还推导了精确冷却曲线，证明至少两个辅助量子比特对于非平凡冷却既是必要的也是充分的，并表明联合多目标冷却可严格优于并行单目标策略。</p></details> | 2026-07-26 | Mattia Reda et al. |
| 9 | **[Routing Techniques for Error-Corrected Silicon Spin Qubit Quantum Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.07822v2)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>Silicon spin qubits have emerged as a promising qubit technology due to their favorable scaling and fabrication properties. Existing compilation approaches for spin qubits either largely ignore error correction, despite its critical role for large-scale quantum computation, or focus on low-level schedule constructions, missing a high-level compilation and routing for logical, error-corrected algorithms. To address this gap, we introduce a compilation framework for spin qubits based on the recent snakes on a plane model, which utilizes a 2D surface code and qubit teleportation to mitigate errors. Building on this model, we propose shortest-path and rotation-based algorithms as two novel classes of qubit-routing techniques, along with additional defect-handling and initial-mapping strategies. An open-source implementation of our framework is publicly available on GitHub as part of the Munich Quantum Toolkit (MQT) at https://github.com/munich-quantum-toolkit/spin-qubit-routing.</p></details><details><summary>中文</summary><p>硅自旋量子比特因其良好的可扩展性和制造特性而成为有前景的量子比特技术。然而，将量子电路高效编译到自旋量子比特平台仍具挑战性，尤其是在考虑硬件约束和对静态缺陷的高敏感性时。现有自旋量子比特编译方法要么在很大程度上忽略纠错（尽管纠错对大规模量子计算至关重要），要么专注于底层调度构造，缺乏对逻辑纠错算法的高层编译与路由。为填补这一空白，我们基于最近的"平面蛇"模型引入了一个自旋量子比特编译框架，该模型利用二维表面码和量子比特隐形传态来抑制错误。在此模型基础上，我们提出了基于最短路径和基于旋转的两类新型量子比特路由算法，以及额外的缺陷处理和初始映射策略。我们在多种架构设置和问题规模下评估了这两种算法，表明最短路径方法在稀疏、低缺陷场景中表现优异，而基于旋转的方法在高密度环境中性能更佳。我们框架的开源实现作为慕尼黑量子工具包（MQT）的一部分，公开于GitHub：https://github.com/munich-quantum-toolkit/spin-qubit-routing。</p></details> | 2026-07-25 | Julian Shen et al. |
| 10 | **[Revisiting the invariant ring of two-qubit mixed states](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23039v1)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>Local unitary equivalence serves as the cornerstone for classifying entanglement in bipartite quantum systems. | 11 | **[Mixed spin-boson coupling for qubit readout with suppressed residual shot-noise dephasing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.13411v2)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>Direct dipole coupling between a two-level system and a bosonic mode describes the interactions present in a wide range of physical platforms. | 12 | **[The Impact of Qubit Connectivity on Quantum Advantage in Noisy IQP Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12635v2)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial-time (IQP) circuits are a candidate for demonstrating near-term quantum advantage, as their sampling task is believed to be classically hard in the ideal theoretical setting under standard complexity-theoretic assumptions. | 15 | **[Harnessing subspace controllability: Dynamical generation of Dicke states in Heisenberg-coupled qubit arrays with a single local control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.24406v4)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>We explore the feasibility of realizing Dicke states in qubit arrays with always-on isotropic Heisenberg coupling between adjacent qubits, assuming a single Zeeman-type control acting in the $z$ direction on an actuator qubit. | 16 | **[Device-Independent Self-Testing of the Three-Qubit CCZ Hypergraph State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.21288v1)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>The three-qubit CCZ state is the smallest rank-three hypergraph state and an elementary entangled magic resource. | 17 | **[Absent, Not Faint: Fisher-Information Limits and a Logarithmic Measurement-Design Cure for Passive Characterization of Coherent Qubit Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.21663v1)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>Calibrating a quantum processor means estimating error parameters, and estimation theory usually assumes a parameter hard to estimate is faint: its signal is weak but present, so more repetitions or a richer model will recover it. This assumption fails for a leading hardware fault. A coherent over-rotation is a small systematic gate miscalibration. Measured through the cheapest data a device returns--one fixed-basis histogram--it is not faint but absent: to first order it leaves the distribution unchanged, indistinguishable from a compensating stochastic error, exactly as two numbers cannot be separated from their sum. For commuting single- and two-qubit transverse over-rotations, with known support on the canonical input, the histogram's Fisher information is singular along the fault's direction at zero angle, its Cramer-Rao bound is infinite, and no finite-variance, locally unbiased estimator recovers it. At a generic nonzero angle the degeneracy partly lifts; beyond four qubits it clears entirely, leaving conditioning, not absence, as the obstruction. The cure is a richer measurement, not a richer model: a fixed, logarithmically small set of extra settings makes every such fault visible. Visibility alone is not enough. Non-commuting faults and unknown support remain open.</p></details><details><summary>中文</summary><p>校准量子处理器意味着估计误差参数，而估计理论通常假设难以估计的参数是微弱的：其信号虽弱但存在，因此更多重复或更丰富的模型可以恢复它。这一假设对于一种主要的硬件故障不成立。相干过旋转是一种小的系统性门校准误差。通过设备返回的最廉价数据——一个固定基矢的直方图——来测量时，它不是微弱而是缺失的：在一阶近似下它不改变分布，与补偿性的随机误差无法区分，正如两个数字无法从它们的和中分离出来。对于对易的单量子比特和双量子比特横向过旋转，在已知标准输入上的支撑时，直方图的Fisher信息沿故障方向在零角度处是奇异的，其Cramér-Rao界是无穷大，且不存在有限方差、局部无偏的估计器能恢复它。在一般的非零角度下，简并性部分解除；超过四个量子比特后，简并性完全消失，留下的障碍是条件数而非缺失。解决方法是更丰富的测量，而非更丰富的模型：一组固定的、对数小的额外设置使每个此类故障变得可见。仅可见性是不够的。采样成本由条件数而非覆盖范围决定，通过一个下界，其完整族闭式表达式在量子比特数量上是指数小的。我们证明了这种不可能性及其解决方法，在精确模拟中验证了二者，展示了条件数可预测数百种设计中的恢复误差，并在IBM Heron硬件上观察到3-5倍的偏差差距作为一致性检验。非对易故障和未知支撑仍然是待解决的问题。</p></details> | 2026-07-23 | Yi Pan et al. |
| 18 | **[Component-Level Inverse Design of Transmon Qubits Using Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20795v1)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>Designing a superconducting qubit to realize specific Hamiltonian parameters typically requires iterating through a time and compute-intensive forward loop in which the designer chooses a layout geometry, simulates it, extracts circuit parameters such as capacitances, and refines the geometry. A single pipeline query takes approximately 56 ms on CPU, versus approximately 2 min for a conventional EM capacitance extraction on the same hardware, a speedup of more than 2,100 times. Batching minimizes the AI model inference overhead, reducing the runtime to 0.24 ms per sample on CPU and 2.5 microseconds per sample on GPU, resulting in speedups of 5.0 x 10^5 and 4.8 x 10^7, respectively, relative to a single conventional CPU EM extraction. Our results indicate that component-level inverse design usefully extends and complements conventional EM simulation, including for small datasets on the order of 1,000 samples.</p></details><details><summary>中文</summary><p>设计超导量子比特以实现特定哈密顿量参数通常需要迭代执行耗时且计算密集的正向循环：设计者选择布局几何结构、进行仿真、提取电容等电路参数，并优化几何结构。我们利用神经网络工作流研究该任务的逆版本，将目标哈密顿量参数直接映射到元件级布局参数，随后在平面传输子量子比特布局上进行验证。训练期间，我们将逆模型与冻结的正向代理模型配对，并在哈密顿量空间而非布局参数空间中评估损失。与传统电磁求解器的验证表明，97%的生成设计产生可用几何结构，逆模型加代理流水线在量子比特频率和非谐性上分别达到0.73%和1.58%的平均百分比误差，与学术工艺中此类传输子量子比特预期的制造及仿真-测量不确定性相当或更低。单次流水线查询在CPU上耗时约56毫秒，而同一硬件上传统电磁电容提取约需2分钟，加速比超过2100倍。批处理最小化AI模型推理开销，将CPU上每样本运行时间降至0.24毫秒，GPU上降至2.5微秒，相对于单次传统CPU电磁提取分别实现5.0×10^5和4.8×10^7的加速比。结果表明，元件级逆向设计有效扩展并补充了传统电磁仿真，包括对约1000样本量的小数据集。</p></details> | 2026-07-22 | Olivia Seidel et al. |
| 19 | **[Statevector-Referenced Geometry Survival of a Four-Qubit ZZ Quantum Kernel on IBM Quantum Hardware: A Fixed-Subset Diagnostic Across Three Execution Configurations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20377v1)** | <details><summary>EN</summary><p>Quantum-kernel methods encode a dataset's geometry in a Gram matrix, so learning claims on hardware kernels assume the intended geometry survives execution. We measure that survival for one frozen four-qubit ZZ feature-map kernel on $N=24$ real indoor air-quality windows, reconstructed on ibm_fez (1024 shots per circuit) under baseline, dynamical decoupling alone, and gate twirling alone, each a single non-interleaved job. Every configuration returned a complete, finite, positive-semidefinite Gram matrix and preserved the centered statevector geometry to a substantial but incomplete descriptive degree (full-matrix centered kernel alignment, CKA, 0.933-0.989). Gate twirling was most faithful on every reported geometry axis, with the only jackknife-resolved improvement over baseline (persisted Spearman, mean absolute error, and full-matrix CKA diagnostics); dynamical decoupling alone was not separated from baseline at the frozen-window scale. Residual hardware distortion, not finite sampling, dominates the discrepancy. Yet fidelity and label alignment were reversed: the most faithful configuration had the lowest centered kernel-target alignment, which sits at or below label-permutation references for statevector and hardware alike. We read the small hardware uplift as a normalization property of the non-affine distortion, not captured signal. These are descriptive results for single jobs on one backend, not causal mitigation-efficacy estimates; no quantum-advantage, hardware-classifier-superiority, or forecasting claim is made. Implementation fidelity and task relevance are distinct axes; hardware quantum machine-learning studies should report both.</p></details><details><summary>中文</summary><p>量子核方法将数据集的几何结构编码在格拉姆矩阵中，因此基于硬件核的学习主张假定预期的几何结构在运行中得以保留。我们针对一个冻结的四量子比特ZZ特征映射核，在N=24个真实室内空气质量时间窗口上，测量了该几何结构的保留程度。该核在ibm_fez量子处理器上重建（每个电路1024次采样），分别采用基线配置、仅动态解耦和仅门电路扭摆三种方式，每种均为单一非交错任务。每个配置都返回了一个完整、有限、半正定的格拉姆矩阵，并将中心化态矢量几何结构保留到了可观但不完全的描述程度（全矩阵中心化核对齐，CKA，0.933-0.989）。在所有报告的几何结构轴上，门电路扭摆的忠实度最高，且是唯一通过刀切法验证优于基线的配置（持续斯皮尔曼相关系数、平均绝对误差和全矩阵CKA诊断指标）；仅动态解耦在冻结窗口尺度上与基线无显著差异。残差硬件失真（而非有限采样）是差异的主要来源。然而，保真度与标签对齐却呈现反向关系：最忠实的配置具有最低的中心化核-目标对齐度，该对齐度对于态矢量和硬件而言均处于或低于标签置换参考值。我们将较小的硬件提升解读为非仿射失真的归一化性质，而非捕获到的信号。这些是针对单一后端上单个任务的描述性结果，并非因果缓解效能的估计；本文未提出任何量子优势、硬件分类器优越性或预测性主张。实现保真度与任务相关性是不同维度；硬件量子机器学习研究应同时报告两者。</p></details> | 2026-07-22 | Rostyslav Sipakov et al. |
